**The lock screen is themed again.** It never was: the skin asked Steam for class names the interface does not
use, so every rule landed on nothing. The lock screen now targets the real ones, harvested from Steam's own
code, and the PIN pad, the dot indicators and the login prompt all wear the Void Deck look — black, hairline
borders, dot-matrix digits.

**A shorter startup movie, and one you can watch.** The CtOS sequence is now 5.5 seconds instead of 8.5: the
long tail is gone and the silent track with it. It is also no longer only a boot video — the panel plays it as a
preview, so you can see what the Deck will do before you restart it.

**Everything else stayed as it was.** The keyboard, the downloads page, the compatibility badges, the Home
screen and the custom Home keep the treatment they had in 1.6.0, and the plugin still only changes how Steam
looks, never how it works.

**Install / update:** grab `VoidDeck-v1.7.1.zip` from the [v1.7.1 release](https://github.com/endoflineservice/VoidDeck/releases/tag/v1.7.1), or press **Update now** in the Void Deck panel.
